headline: Owner at Whitaker Freight Services | Freight Broker & Logistics Consultant | CTB | TN Freight Assoc Board
summary: Freight broker and logistics consultant serving the Southeast and Midwest since 1997. Founder of Whitaker Freight Services, a Knoxville brokerage specializing in automotive parts, agricultural products, and building materials. FMCSA licensed, Certified Transportation Broker. Board member, Tennessee Freight Association. Co-lead of the TN Freight Mentorship Program.
